We need number of carbonyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use minimal experiments. Probably easiest: IR spectra to see C=O peak around 1700 cm-1. Could be multiple peaks. Use IR tool.

Let's call ir_spectra.
